title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The enhanced access to high-quality health and nutrition services programme in Bangladesh implemented by Concern Worldwide aims to contribute to improved resilience of populations in Cox's Bazar living in camps for the displaced. The objectives of the grant is to improve the nutritional status of children, adolescent girls and pregnant and lactating women; to support refugees and host communities to prepare for and respond better to shocks such as floods, landslide and cyclones; and to improve the capacity of national partners and other community structures to implement emergency nutrition and security interventions. OBJECTIVES: Shocks (natural or man-made) in targeted camps and the host communities are anticipated and prepared for and responded to in a timely manner.OUTCOMES: To contribute to well-being of the people in camps and in the surrounding host community
